We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline.

We need 3 steps retrosynthesis. Likely disconnections:

1. Disconnection of amide bond: target amide C(=O)N attached to aniline (c3ccccc3N). So retrosynthetic step: break amide to give carboxylic acid (or activated acid) and aniline. So precursor: p-tolyl-sulfonyl phenyl-CH=CH-COOH (or acid chloride) plus aniline.

2. Disconnection of the α,β-unsaturated acid: use Doebner modification: break the C=C bond to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) and malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid. So retrosynthesis: break the C=C and carbonyl to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) and malonic acid (or its derivative). So precursor: aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) attached to sulfonyl group? Wait the aldehyde is on the phenyl ring that is attached to sulfonyl. So we need p-tolyl-sulfonyl phenyl-CHO (i.e., sulfonyl attached to phenyl bearing aldehyde). So step 2: target unsaturated acid derived from aldehyde + malonic acid.

3. Disconnection of sulfonamide: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride) and aniline (p-tolyl amine). Actually forward sulfonamide formation: amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide. So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give p-tolyl amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl-sulfonyl chloride? Wait the sulfonyl group is attached to the phenyl ring (the second phenyl). Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to the first phenyl (p-tolyl) as NS(=O)(=O) attached to second phenyl. The sulfonamide nitrogen is attached to the p-tolyl phenyl (the first phenyl). So the sulfonyl chloride precursor would be p-tolyl-sulfonyl chloride (i.e., p-tolyl-SO2Cl). The amine partner would be the second phenyl bearing the unsaturated acid (the aldehyde precursor). So step 3: sulfonamide formation.

Thus three steps: (1) amide coupling, (2) Doebner condensation, (3) sulfonamide formation.
